mwbsjx:159: Serverless container scheduling based on Function Compute has unique value for Agent scenarios: AI Agent request volumes are typically highly imbalanced—possibly no requests for long periods, then sudden spikes. AgentRun's automatic scale-to-zero capability resolves this contradiction, billing based on actual session request count, which is especially friendly to startup teams and projects in the validation phase.
